evaluation: Historical real-bug replay on urllib3 2.2.3 with authored tests; not held out.
issue: In requests.utils.super_len, a Unicode string body reports the number of characters instead of its UTF-8 byte length. With the installed urllib3 2.2.3, string bodies are UTF-8 encoded, so Content-Length is wrong for non-ASCII text. Fix super_len while preserving ASCII, bytes and partially consumed file-like object lengths. Do not make network requests.
